cases.observed_defect: The relative's preposition and the arrival goal are now linked. The participle spent still treats days as agent and in as a particle.
cases.required_linguistic_correction: Proper locative/manner PP and passive/reduced-relative relation of days spent

cases.observed_defect: The root has no selected THEME/OBJECT relation from conceive to the horrors
cases.required_linguistic_correction: Conceive governs the horrors, with as-clause subordinate and its own agents

cases.observed_defect: `at` in `at once` becomes N, and `captain's` is interpreted as COPULA
cases.required_linguistic_correction: Temporal PP and source genitive `dead captain's body`

cases.observed_defect: The affirmative report now records its perfect auxiliary. The negated reply and the plural subject of agreed are still wrong.
cases.required_linguistic_correction: Preserve negative minor response and we all as the subject of agreed

cases.observed_defect: Independent grammatical contrast He shake his head. (uninflected finite third-person singular shake) is nevertheless assigned the same selected clause_np_vp construction as He shook his head.; semantic accuracy of the positive does not overcome this morphological overgeneration.
cases.required_linguistic_correction: Require the correct lexical tense/person-number agreement in the selected finite clause; preserve the original head POSSESSOR and shake AGENT/PATIENT semantics while rejecting the inflection contrast.

cases.observed_defect: The copular predicate identifies we as its predicand. The PP in intervals remains misanalysed as a nominal apposition.
cases.required_linguistic_correction: Intervals when left alone is a locative-temporal adjunct, not apposition of me

cases.observed_defect: RECIPIENT(had,knee) mislabels on her knee; which would have lasted attaches to basket
cases.required_linguistic_correction: Knee is location for basket and relative which modifies basket of refreshments

cases.observed_defect: The negator now attaches to be, but here is selected as an adjectival attribute, and the without-regrets PP is a TOPIC of occupied rather than a condition on the speaker's being near Agnes.
cases.required_linguistic_correction: Select locative here and coordinated nearness to Agnes under the modal, with the without-regrets condition attached to that experience and the relative clause modifying regrets.

cases.observed_defect: `voice` in `in a low voice` is selected V, governing `REPORTED_CONTENT(voice,Be)`
cases.required_linguistic_correction: Reporting predicate is `added`, with manner PP `in a low voice`

cases.observed_defect: Service is no longer an agent of the selected copular constituent, but read is still nominal and the true passive and remembered relative are not composed.
cases.required_linguistic_correction: Source passive verbal `read`, remembered location relative, and coordinated motion

cases.observed_defect: Church is now the goal of went. The matrix negative perfect still selects had as a lexical verb and a false subject.
cases.required_linguistic_correction: Negative perfect auxiliary inversion and subject `I` of `said`

cases.observed_defect: As is no longer labelled a volitional agent, but it still occupies the predicand slot instead of introducing the parenthetical about the custom.
cases.required_linguistic_correction: Treat as was his custom as a parenthetical comparative statement of retired

cases.observed_defect: Second were familiar is given AGENT(were,horses), ignoring neither carriage nor livery as its subject
cases.required_linguistic_correction: Horses were post is one clause; carriage/livery coordinated subject of second were familiar

cases.observed_defect: Existent `There` selected N as AGENT of `is`; negative relative clause not scoped
cases.required_linguistic_correction: Existential there + correct negated `can overcome`

cases.observed_defect: `blue coat` contains `blue` N and `coat` V with `AGENT(coat,blue)`
cases.required_linguistic_correction: Noun `coat` modified by adjective `blue`, object of `wore`

cases.observed_defect: NEGATION(been,not) is restored, but had is still a participial modifier of Bingley and the when-clause is apposed to years.
cases.required_linguistic_correction: Compose the past perfect had been of age, measure its duration, and attach a separate temporal when-clause.

cases.observed_defect: exercise is selected V and given is N inside exercise had given to her complexion
cases.required_linguistic_correction: exercise is noun subject, had auxiliary, given past participle governing brilliancy/result

cases.observed_defect: The graph lacks COMPLEMENT(promised,watch) and ties if condition to promised instead of watch/give
cases.required_linguistic_correction: Promised governs watching and giving; if any new object should appear conditions those actions

cases.observed_defect: The coordinate nominal father, brothers, Elizabeth attaches CONJUNCT(how,brothers), not a list object of left
cases.required_linguistic_correction: How modifies left, with father/brothers/Elizabeth coordinated objects of left

cases.observed_defect: `a kind of panic` contains `panic` V with `AGENT(panic,kind of)`
cases.required_linguistic_correction: `panic` noun as affective state experienced by `I`

cases.observed_defect: A copular subject is no longer labelled agent, but where is still assigned the false predicand and the topographical inversion remains wrong.
cases.required_linguistic_correction: Montanvert belongs to the main copular statement, `rose` is inverted finite verb with Mont Blanc subject

cases.observed_defect: nets were cast has were selected as V and AGENT(cast,where)
cases.required_linguistic_correction: were cast is passive with nets as patient, independent of where he had disappeared

cases.observed_defect: Krempe is the copular predicand rather than agent. The title M. remains detached and the second-clause subject teacher is still misanalysed.
cases.required_linguistic_correction: Recognize the title M. Krempe and keep teacher as subject of the second clause with therefore as its discourse modifier.

cases.observed_defect: `Oh` is a PERSON node in intercalated dialogue
cases.required_linguistic_correction: Overt exclamation/interjection, distinct from a person

cases.observed_defect: we had shoved off and given way selects had as V and given as ADJ with ATTRIBUTE(had,shoved)
cases.required_linguistic_correction: Past-perfect auxiliary had scopes over coordinated shove off and give way events

cases.observed_defect: The partitive demonstrative no longer points to itself. The existential negation and its two exceptions are still not composed correctly.
cases.required_linguistic_correction: There existential introduces absent sound; but that denotes exception and following gerund belongs to breakers

cases.observed_defect: Then now marks temporal order of brought. The possessive ship's counter and relative's nominal attachment remain wrong.
cases.required_linguistic_correction: Preserve ship genitive and attach boat-relative, with dropped as Redruth's shared-subject verb

cases.observed_defect: He is no longer labelled an agent of be, but the nominal analysis of asking still blocks the required progressive.
cases.required_linguistic_correction: asking is present participle of ask and defines what old buccaneer was asking

cases.observed_defect: he did is treated as a coordinated full event of owed rather than emphatic auxiliary reprise
cases.required_linguistic_correction: he did is elliptical auxiliary reprise of owed me money; no new lexical action

cases.observed_defect: The morning is now a predicand in the selected construction, but the stranded spatial preposition in is still treated as a noun attribute.
cases.required_linguistic_correction: in is a stranded source preposition with the copular abroad clause, not an attribute noun

cases.observed_defect: `it must have been` selects `it` POSS, `must` N, `have` N
cases.required_linguistic_correction: Copular perfect modal chain, not an NP headed by must

cases.observed_defect: All of a shiver is represented without a partitive self-loop. The causative chatter still assigns its actor to making instead of teeth.
cases.required_linguistic_correction: teeth is actual subject of chatter; making expresses causation by Mr Dick

cases.observed_defect: MANNER(gave,away) incorrectly attaches away from she went away to gave
cases.required_linguistic_correction: away modifies went, and that she went away is the result clause of such delight

cases.observed_defect: `Oh dear me` opens with `Oh` N and `me` N; source do-support is read V
cases.required_linguistic_correction: Exclamation + yes/no question and reported speech, not nominal `Oh`

cases.observed_defect: CONJUNCT(one,table) coordinates a hand with the table, not one hand with the other
cases.required_linguistic_correction: One of his hands and the other are coordinated absolutive/participial descriptions; table locative

cases.observed_defect: `Master` is V in the resumed source quotation
cases.required_linguistic_correction: Vocative `Master Copperfield`, no verb `master`

cases.observed_defect: had in I had put my chair away is selected lexical V, not finite perfect auxiliary
cases.required_linguistic_correction: had auxiliary scopes over put, with I subject, before was going out

cases.observed_defect: Monetary `six pounds ten per annum` becomes a V `pounds` with `AFFECTED(pounds,annum)`
cases.required_linguistic_correction: Numeric salary rate nominal, not a verbal event

cases.observed_defect: `corner` in `in a corner` becomes V with an affected relative `where`
cases.required_linguistic_correction: Locative PP and an actual existential `there used to be`

cases.observed_defect: `herself` is selected DEGREE, `at present` contains `present` V
cases.required_linguistic_correction: Reflexive object/complement and temporal `at present` PP

cases.observed_defect: or is selected N in or rather taller and APPOSITION(height,or)
cases.required_linguistic_correction: or rather taller is discourse correction of height comparison, not appositional noun

cases.observed_defect: NEGATION(remind,not) is restored, but so is still the object of discourage and often attaches to discourage, not coming.
cases.required_linguistic_correction: Compose the possessive gerund with subject his and the frequency phrase so very often as a modifier of coming.

cases.observed_defect: Bingley is now a predicand, but had still functions as a lexical verb and the perfect copula remains unrecognised.
